quests.title: Stronghold Guard: Hoard Guard Unit!

dialogue.t: Oh hey there, {NICKNAME}! Hello, Paimon!
Since we ran into each other, wanna see my weasel, Sproutie? I've got it with me, and it's super adorable!
...Meow?
Hey, hey, hey, that's not how you're supposed to sound, Sproutie! I don't think the two of them here understand Ashru's tongue anyway.
...Coo?
No, speaking like finches won't work here either. Miss Basima has already returned to Sumeru to recuperate.
I'm sorry, Sproutie is clearly a little confused after hanging out so much with the other animals. It can't quite find its own wavelength, heh heh...
I should let it rest for a while.

dialogue.sit: Are you an animal expert too?
Are you a friend of animals too?

dialogue.t: Hmm... Why does Paimon get the sense that you're talking to us like we're already old friends? Did you run a background check on us or something?
Relax, relax... We're on the same team...
I work for Miss Yelan, and you're her absolute, top-tier, number-one guests. I don't even need to tell you how close that makes us, right?

dialogue.sit: Yeah, that does make you one of us.
Any friend of Yelan's is a friend of ours too.

dialogue.t: Gosh, you should've said so sooner! Paimon was getting a little nervous for a second there...
Anyway, what are you doing here in the middle of nowhere with Sproutie?
We're standing guard here... Or rather, I'm checking to see if my "Hoard Guard Unit" can actually work properly.
Since we're on the same side, I guess there's no harm in telling you...
I have a supply point hidden underground, not far from here. However, the gate's been getting busted open by monsters left and right lately.
So, at great personal expense, I had the Whiz-Kid Mechanic over at Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop build me my very own guard unit.
Ahem, more accurately speaking, it's really more like a security system. One that's capable of identifying deployment locations, with multiple functions that can be combined in various ways.
Talk about good timing! The Whiz-Kid is showcasing her work at a convention soon. She sold me this set as an early test run.
So, I set up a layered defense for the supply point. It's an open invitation for our honored guests — I mean, monsters — to walk straight into my trap.
Now, not only can we test out different ways to protect the supply point, but we'll also gather plenty of data for the Whiz-Kid. Talk about killing two birds with one stone!

dialogue.sit: You've managed to snag yourself one of Aino's creations, I see.

dialogue.t: Wanna give it a whirl? I've already used them to fend off quite a number of monsters. It's quite the stress reliever, actually.
Come on, give it a try. You can let off some steam, and I might be able to learn something from your approach at the same time!
Of course, you'll be handsomely remunerated. Since we're all on the same team, it's only fair that I pay you twice the standard consultant rate.

dialogue.sit: Too right! We're on the same team, so you can't be stingy!

dialogue.t: Hmm... Yeah! Helping you is helping Yelan anyway, so everybody wins!
Alright then! We'll show you what experience looks like in practice!

quests.description: In Nod-Krai, you encounter a messenger named Blue Bolt, who seems to be testing a certain mechanical defense unit…
